articles.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
articles.snippet: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

articles.title: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets
articles.snippet: A new XRPL amendment proposal would let institutions encrypt token balances and transfer amounts while still giving issuers, auditors and regulators selective access.

articles.title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs post best week since April with $1B inflows
articles.snippet: The spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds registered their third-strongest showing since October as institutional demand showed signs of renewed momentum.

articles.title: Fierce backlash to Ethereum’s EIP-8363 staking proposal
articles.snippet: Ethereum’s proposed EIP-8363 staking overhaul aims to reduce issuance, but critics say it could hurt DeFi, decentralization and institutional adoption.

articles.title: CLARITY Act delay gives Asian financial hubs an opening: First Digital CEO
articles.snippet: Industry figures warned that continued legislative limbo could slow institutional adoption, revive regulation by enforcement and push innovation offshore.
